original_ai_output.title_zh: 奥贡州萨加穆路段发生交通事故，多人受伤
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥贡州萨加穆路段发生一起交通事故，多人受伤，应急人员到场救治伤者。现场视频显示有伤者躺倒在路面上，数名男子试图营救被困在严重受损商业巴士内的伤者。截至报道发出时，伤亡人数尚无法立即确认。

key_facts.fact: 奥贡州萨加穆路段发生交通事故，多人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Many people were left injured following a road accident in the Sagamu axis of Ogun State

key_facts.fact: 应急人员到场救治伤者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: with emergency responders attending to victims at the scene

key_facts.fact: 现场视频显示伤者躺倒在路面上，有人试图营救被困在受损商业巴士内的伤者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Several men were also seen attempting to rescue victims trapped inside a badly damaged commercial bus.

key_facts.fact: 截至报道发出时伤亡人数尚无法立即确认
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The number of casualties could not be immediately ascertained as of the time of filing this report.
